mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC over 2 years is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression of 20-day returns on the product of RSAFS and HOUST growth rates over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0), the manufacturing sector slowdown signals reduced corporate output and potential earnings cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during a supply-constrained economic cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0 and the economy is in a supply-constrained cycle, or the Rank IC is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs per month indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 550,000 units per month, it signals a rebound in the housing sector that stimulates related industries and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 550.0, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 for two consecutive months indicates a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC over 3 years is negative.
